The changelog records active maintenance and the required 2025-06-14 compatibility change; the separate matured farm deprecation does not retire siUSD. No project shutdown, team disbanding, wind-down or siUSD retirement notice was found in these reviewed official sources. This is source-based lifecycle admission, not a fresh runtime-availability attestation.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official Ethereum table labels this address Gateway V1 and separately lists siUSD. The documentation V1 example stake(uint256) is not substituted for the actual implementation ABI. Initial constructor implementation is not used as the applicable interface.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full 40-function applicable implementation ABI and separate complete proxy ABI retained. Service labels exact_match for proxy and match for implementation are recorded verbatim. Binding is via exact chain/address proxyResolution and exact reported implementation compilation, not a generic ERC4626 or repository ABI. No fresh RPC bytecode, storage, dependency registry or execution verification was performed.

selectedFunctions.label: infiniFi siUSD stake
warnings: Calls target the Ethereum infiniFi Gateway proxy, not the siUSD token directly. Official docs state the 2025-06-14 YieldSharing upgrade broke direct siUSD ERC4626 compatibility; the gateway distributes interpolated rewards and temporarily opens its privileged staking-entry flag.

stake consumes caller iUSD receipt-token units and mints siUSD shares to _to; unstake consumes caller siUSD shares and sends iUSD to _to, not USDC. Caller must approve the gateway for the input token. Choose the intended nonzero recipient and send zero native value.

No siUSD cooldown or locked-position unbonding step appears in these two explicit methods. They do not unlock liUSD-xw (separate 1-13 week unbonding positions), perform USDC redemption, bridge, zap, or guarantee an end-to-end cash exit.

Gateway pause/reentrancy guards, siUSD pause/max checks, pending negative unaccrued yield and YieldSharing dependencies may block calls. Pending-loss accrual is not performed by stake/unstake and no independent YieldSharing capability is admitted.

Amounts are not guaranteed 1:1: vault conversions use current totalAssets and floor rounding; small positive amounts can produce zero shares/assets. Neither admitted function has min-output or deadline parameters. Rewards interpolation, donations, losses and principal slashing can change exchange rates.

The gateway is upgradeable and governor-controlled registry entries select stakedToken, receiptToken and yieldSharing; roles, pauses, dependencies and arbitrary emergency administrative powers remain authoritative. Source-service proxy resolution is evidence, not a fresh bytecode/configuration attestation or promise that these dependencies persist.

Admission grants no API-key permission, bypasses no canonical calldata/value, grant or pause checks, and guarantees neither backing, liquidity, live balances, yield, financial safety nor successful execution.
